method: WebSearch/WebFetch, at most 4 lookups per pair, queries limited to facility name, city and service. Run 2026-11-21.

results.notes: Own website lists Dialysis among specialities; address Delapeer, Stadium Road, Bareilly 243122 matches. Only source is the hospital's own site (same source the record was built from); nephrology not named there.

Dialysis at Sadar Hospital Gopalganj is real but run by NephroPlus (Ward 15, Banakata, Gopalganj 841428), not Apollo; the Apollo affiliation claim comes from a Justdial Allahabad page and is contaminated. The blood bank name itself was not verified.
Own website says around 50 caesarean deliveries monthly; BK Road, Cuttack 753001 matches. No independent source; 24x7 emergency availability not verified.

Tribune (5 Dec 2024): no gynaecologist, many women referred out for caesareans, but private panel doctors perform caesareans (about 300 deliveries/month incl. caesareans). Record PIN 132001 is a Karnal PIN, not Kaithal. Capability is limited and unreliable for emergencies.
Hospital exists in Hoshangabad (Double Phatak, Harda Bypass Road), NABH accredited, PM-JAY empanelled. The cited group-site hospital page returns 404; no independent page found mentioning a NICU.

Shillong Times (June 2025) reports a real partnership with Motherhood Hospitals for NICU Live remote monitoring of the hospital's neonatal care, so the 'other facility named' flag is a false positive. Gov page gives Pohkseh, Shillong 793014. Own NICU bed count not confirmed.
Own website lists Cardiology & CTVS (cardiovascular surgery); Vyapar Vihar Rd, Talapara, Bilaspur 495001 matches. No independent source on surgical volume or surgeons.

Singla Children Hospital is a single-specialty paediatric clinic (Sanoli Road, Panipat 132103 vs record 132108). The CTVS claim and description belong to Dr Prem Super Speciality Hospital, Panipat: merged record.

Wikipedia lists 1.5 T MRI and 128-slice CT in the Advanced Imaging Centre; a college listing says radiodiagnosis offers MRI. Government 316-bed hospital in Silvassa. Official site vbch.dnh.nic.in did not resolve, so no primary confirmation.

The 3T MRI (Rs 30 crore) and PET-MRI belong to Gauhati Medical College & Hospital (allopathic) CN Centre, not a homoeopathic college hospital. Record name merges three cities; Assam homoeopathic hospitals list only X-ray/USG/ECG.
Own site: 43-bed secondary care centre at Oshalbag, Dhargal, Pernem 403513 with 24x7 Emergency, ICU and Orthopedics & Trauma; surgeons on call. Only the hospital's own site found.

Medical college page lists SNM District Hospital Firozabad (PIN 283203) with 500 beds and a 17-bed trauma centre. Record PIN 202001 is Aligarh and the description is about S R Critical Care Hospital, Bareilly: contaminated record, real facility does offer trauma care.
